instruction: Please configure VS Code to set the minimap max column width to 120 for the current user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to configure VS Code minimap max column setting to 120. Evaluator checks the settings.json file for the correct key-value pair. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VS Code user settings file from the standard Linux location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly verifies that the expected key-value pair exists in the JSON file
Expected value {"editor.minimap.maxColumn": 120} precisely matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: single requirement (set minimap max column to 120) is fully verified by the evaluator
Data flow is correct: vm_file getter retrieves the file, metric loads and parses JSON, then compares expected values
Robust error handling: metric returns 0.0 for missing files or JSON parsing errors
Settings file is persistent and requires no postconfig since VS Code automatically saves settings
Uses sentinel pattern to correctly distinguish between missing keys and None values

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
